findings.issue: The two C1135 negatives were generated by copying their controls and changing only the END DO line, so their '! rule:' and '! covers:' headers still named the CONTROL's rule and facet (R1122, unnamed-nonlabel-do-stmt) while the manifests claimed C1135. The test module only counted headers.
findings.resolution: Headers regenerated; the unit test now compares every header value against the manifest. The negatives still differ from their controls only in header comments and the END DO line, and remain anchored at line 17.

adjudications: 11.1.7.2 is FORM; execution semantics in 11.1.7.4/11.1.7.5 are not claimed.
Label-DO fixtures carry an after-label counter that must NOT increment per iteration, proving the labeled statement ends the range.
R1129/R1130 locality specs are claimed as admission only.
The C1135 different-name obligation is distinct and remains pending within the packet cap.
